subject: Request to move Dec 14 demo — coverage week conflict
messages:
From: Alan Miller <alan@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Katie Long <katie@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — Dec 14 demo (possible move)

Hi Priyom,

Quick note — our executive team just confirmed attendance at a regional meeting the week of Dec 13 and we have a travel blackout for the product team on the 14th. Would you be able to move our scheduled demo (Dec 14, 10:00 AM PT) to another day? Katie and I can be flexible the week before (Dec 7–10) or the following week (Dec 15–17) in the mornings PT.

Also flagging that our internal holiday coverage starts Dec 22; if we push into late December it'll be tougher for us to get the full decision-makers on the call. If there's a recorded option or a short executive summary you can send, that would help.

I've attached our current agenda for context (current-agenda.pdf).

Appreciate the help — Alan
Alan Miller
Head of Partnerships, Greenleaf Health
alan@greenleafhealth.com

[Attachment: current-agenda.pdf]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Miller <alan@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Katie Long <katie@greenleafhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — Dec 14 demo (possible move)

Thanks for the heads up, Alan — absolutely, we can work something out.

Short summary of constraints on our side: we have an internal holiday/on-call coverage window the week of Dec 21–27 and a larger attendance drop the week of Dec 13 because a portion of our solutions and SE teams will be at a conference in APAC. That means we have limited full-team availability on Dec 14 specifically.

Options that should work from our side:
- Move earlier: Dec 8 or Dec 9 in the morning PT (these are safe for engineering + product to attend).
- Move later: Dec 15 at 10:00 AM PT — Ben can staff and record the demo, but it will be a lighter engineering presence.
- Alternate: We can run the full technical demo on Dec 9 and then schedule a short executive 30-min summary on Dec 15 to catch the execs.

I've attached a quick .ics with proposed slots for your calendar (proposed-reschedule-slots.ics). Ben and Laura are cc'd to confirm coverage and recording. If any of those options work, let me know and I'll send an updated invite and a recorded fallback.

If you'd prefer, we can also do a short pre-demo sync (15m) to align expectations so the eventual session is decision-focused.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

[Attachment: proposed-reschedule-slots.ics]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Alan Miller <alan@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Katie Long <katie@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 08:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — Dec 14 demo (possible move)

Priyom/Alan — I can cover the Dec 15 slot (10:00 AM PT) and will record the session end-to-end. I can also provide a shorter exec summary (30m) the same day around 2:00 PM PT for any stakeholders who can't make the full demo.

If you go with the Dec 9 + Dec 15 combo Priyom suggested, I'll take the 15th and cover all the deep-dive Q&A. Laura — can you pick up coverage for Dec 9? If not, I can run both but would prefer to split for prep.

I attached the demo runbook we usually use for Greenleaf-style workflows (demo-runbook.pdf) — highlights the recording checklist and key system screenshots we include.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
[Attachment: demo-runbook.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Miller <alan@greenleafhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Katie Long <katie@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — Dec 14 demo (possible move)

Thanks all — happy to pick up the Dec 9 slot at 9:00 AM PT for the full technical run-through. Priyom, I'll follow Ben's runbook and make sure we capture the recording and the short executive recap slides.

Alan/Katie — to lock this down I'd suggest the two-step plan:
1) Technical demo: Dec 9, 9:00 AM PT (60–75m) — Laura runs, Ben records/backs up, Priyom on standby for deep infra Qs.
2) Exec summary: Dec 15, 10:00 AM PT (30m) — Ben runs with a 10-slide decision-focused pack.

If that works for you I will send the calendar invites and include the recording link and the short slide deck in advance. If you only want one session, we can set Dec 15 as the single live session but I'd recommend a short pre-call to align scope.

Next steps: Alan — confirm preferred approach (two-step vs single session) and I'll send invites.

Laura Bennett
Senior Product Specialist, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
